

// package main






struct EmptyMissing {}



struct EmptyExplicit {}



trait MarkerMissing {}



trait MarkerExplicit {}





struct WithField {



    value: i32, // control


}



fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        
let missing = EmptyMissing {}

;


let explicit = EmptyExplicit {}

;


let control = WithField{value: 7} 

;



let _: EmptyMissing = missing;
let _: EmptyExplicit = explicit;
let _: i32 = control.value;
let _: Option<&dyn MarkerMissing> = None;
let _: Option<&dyn MarkerExplicit> = None;



    
}
